title: The Voice Before It Knew It Was Speaking

features.name: the-first-breath
features.desc-on-touch: A sound you feel before you hear it. The archive's own inhalation.

features.name: before-meaning
features.desc-on-touch: Layers of silence stacked so carefully nothing falls. Meaning hasn't arrived yet.

features.name: the-gathering-word
features.desc-on-touch: Marks unreadable to the eye. But if you listen long enough, they teach themselves to speak.

features.name: soil-that-listens
features.desc-on-touch: The earth has learned to be an ear. It hears what you have not yet said.

features.name: threshold-of-utterance
features.desc-on-touch: An opening that opens only inward. Speech must travel backward into silence before it can move forward.
